automatic_release.gate: All five technical results valid, checksums/source/images verified, no surviving experimental containers; no quality-based selection.
automatic_release.on_failure: Stop for inspection, do not retry automatically

hypotheses.architecture_contrast: Each distributed arm versus sequential monolith is secondary descriptive; no claim versus a parallel monolith.
hypotheses.holdout_policy: No tuning or arm selection based on test F1. Test only after validation selection.
hypotheses.interaction: Early-publication x admission-limit interaction is exploratory, reported regardless of sign.
limitations: Single host, single frozen dataset split
No parallel-monolith control in this campaign
20 seeds; fixed seed-shared split does not measure dataset uncertainty
Admission limit includes projection, training and validation and is per IWSSR process, not cluster-wide
Weka training may ignore interruption; supervisor provides hard stop
No batching/telemetry-removal or algorithm-portfolio changes included
Application background workload documented in frozen manifest
hypotheses.primary: Two paired per-seed factorial main effects (early publication and training admission limit) on normalized quality-yield AUC, averaged over the other factor.
hypotheses.primary_test: Two-sided exact paired sign-flip tests over 20 independent seeds, Holm correction across the two main effects; paired bootstrap 95% confidence intervals with seed 20260923 and 20000 replicates.
hypotheses.quality_guardrail: One-sided 95% bootstrap lower bound of mean paired held-out F1 difference versus distributed-e0-b0, margin -0.005; nonsignificance is not equivalence.
hypotheses.quality_yield_auc: Integral of cumulative distinct published subsets with validation macro-F1 >= 0.945, divided by the fixed 2700-second selection horizon. Include zero-yield runs.
secondary_family: CPU-hours and GiB-hours integrated over timestamp-aligned selection samples, with coverage/gaps reported
hypotheses.status: Prespecified before v13 seed 149 pilot; pilot is a technical gate, not configuration selection.
hypotheses.time_to_threshold: Time until a qualified solution is externally available; failures right-censored at selection deadline. Report evaluation-completion-to-publication-submit separately; Kafka acknowledgement/consumer visibility must not be inferred from submission.

order_design.limitations: position balanced; not fully carryover balanced
order_design.type: cyclic Latin square, four complete cycles over 20 seeds

factor_changes: early publication of completed improving candidates
process-wide admission limit for actual IWSSR training

primary_p_method: exact two-sided sign flips, Holm across two main effects
